title: Saving an edited page shows success but the change is lost
clean: After editing a page and clicking Save Page, the page shows the new content and the notice 'Page successfully updated'.
with_bug: The notice 'Page successfully updated' appears, but the page still shows the old content; nothing was saved.
mechanism: Theme functions.php (web_middleware_before): a page update request is answered with BookStack's success notice and a redirect back to the page, without saving.
